name: system-drawings
description: Explorable three-dimensional technical drawings of any system: overview first, drill into sub-assemblies, trace requests step by step, in a minimal 1970s engineering-documentation style.

interface.shortDescription: Explorable 3D technical drawings: overview, drill-down, and request traces.
interface.longDescription: Turns a system, project, mechanism, or concept into a self-contained HTML drawing set in the style of 1970s IBM and NASA documentation. Readers orbit and rearrange line-drawn solids, open data sheets, descend into sub-assemblies, and follow requests step by step. Includes a validator, a builder, and a headless-Chrome inspector with a layout audit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $system-drawings to build an explorable drawing set that explains how this system works.
